answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the economy requires every new identity to post a quadratic bond equal to 80 tokens times its rank among all registrations inside the current 36-hour mesa window. Bonds stay locked for a full 9 days that no payment can shorten. An honest sparrow pays only the base 80; a farm of twenty therefore locks 16800 tokens in total. The growing orchard of frozen capital cannot be amortized or parallelized across wallets.
